build_split_builder: build a SplitBuilder instance to generate dataset splits with configurable beam pipeline and shard settings
create_beam_pipeline: create an Apache Beam pipeline context via SplitBuilder.maybe_beam_pipeline for distributed dataset generation
submit_split_generation: submit split generation tasks with a generator, filename template, and shuffling configuration
normalize_legacy_split_generators: normalize legacy SplitGenerator lists into modern dict-based split generator structures
build_from_generator: build dataset split shards from an iterable of key-example pairs using the Writer class
